response.sql: WITH t AS (SELECT link_to_budget, SUM(cost) AS total, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM expense GROUP BY link_to_budget), a AS (SELECT AVG(total) AS avg_total FROM t) SELECT AVG(t.total) AS avg_total, SUM(t.cnt) AS total_expenses, AVG(t.total - a.avg_total) AS avg_excess FROM t, a WHERE t.total > a.avg_total
